scripts.deploy: pnpm build && wrangler d1 migrations apply mankr-mail --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.init:admin: echo 'Prefer POST /api/setup when users is empty. Or: ADMIN_USERNAME=... ADMIN_PASSWORD=... pnpm --filter @mankr/worker exec tsx scripts/init-admin.ts' && wrangler d1 execute mankr-mail --local --command "SELECT COUNT(*) AS users FROM users"

COOKIES_SECRET.description: Required session cookie signing secret. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Optional. Required when `SEND_CHANNEL=resend` (recommended Total Free arbitrary outbound). Get a free key at [resend.com](https://resend.com).

EMAIL_DOMAIN.description: Your mail domain without `@` (e.g. `example.com`). Aliases become `local@EMAIL_DOMAIN`.

SEND_CHANNEL.description: `resend` (Total Free arbitrary send), `cloudflare` (Paid / verified destination), or `mailchannels`. See docs/DEPLOY.md.
